Mother Lusamine!'') is the 30th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Mina]] arrives on [[Poni Island]], where she finds an injured [[Guzma]]. * [[Wicke]] takes Mina to [[Exeggutor Island]] to train with the other [[Trial Captain]]s. * Guzma is taken to a medical ward, where he explains what happened to him after being kidnapped. * [[Lusamine]] and her {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s try to capture {{p|Necrozma}}. * Necrozma absorbs [[Nebby|Lunala]] to become its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dawn Wings}} form. * {{adv|Sun}} captures {{p|Stakataka}} to use against Lusamine and [[nickname]]s it Drachma. * [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] tell [[Samson Oak]] about the Reassembly Unit and their plan to use it on {{p|Zygarde}}. * {{adv|Moon}} tries to capture Lusamine's {{p|Nihilego}} with a [[Beast Ball]], but refuses as it could potentially hurt Lusamine. {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Mina]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Ribombee}} * {{p|Exeggutor}} ([[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Necrozma}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dawn Wings}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Lillie]] * [[Samson Oak]] * [[Ilima]] * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Acerola]] * [[Sophocles]] * [[Mina]] * [[Hala]] * [[Nanu]] * [[Hapu]] * [[Lysandre]] (flashback;
